candidates.explanation: For the LOCAL file driver, the serialization transform prefixes the relative file path with appConfig().frontendDomain instead of backendDomain. Local files are served by the backend, so avatar URLs point to the frontend host and fail to load.

fix.description: Use backendDomain instead of frontendDomain for the local driver.
